# Bundled libraries

These browser libraries are included locally so core PDF workflows can run without fetching their scripts from a CDN.

- [PDF-Lib 1.17.1](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) — MIT license
- [PDF.js 3.11.174](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) — Apache-2.0 license
- [JSZip 3.10.1](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) — MIT license
- [pdfmake 0.2.12](https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake) — MIT license

Tesseract.js and its English language data are loaded from their public CDN at runtime for OCR.
